end.summary:
Discussed how harvest festivals connect with the season when crops are ready.
Kavya linked new rice to Pongal once.
They identified Makar Sankranti as a winter festival and mentioned tilgud.
Teach-back was not passed; season timing remained mixed up at the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised connecting Pongal with the new rice harvest and Baisakhi with wheat, using a festival-and-crop table. Kavya correctly linked new rice with Pongal once and recalled tilgud for Makar Sankranti. They continued to mix up festival dates and seasons, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, sort a few festivals into seasons and say which crop or harvest each one celebrates.
